title: Corner C4 - Admin Panel Visual Spec
summary: Visual design for AOM's internal admin panel. Fleet overview, client detail, update management, revenue dashboard. Dark theme control room for managing all Corner clients.
content:
Corner C4: Admin Panel Visual Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. The admin panel is AOM's internal power tool. Patrik and Ash use this to manage every Corner client.

Design Philosophy

The admin panel is a control room. Mission control. Not a pretty marketing page, not a clean product interface. This is where Patrik sees everything at once, makes decisions fast, and acts on them.

The feeling: "I have total visibility. Nothing slips past me."

Dark theme. Dense information. High contrast. Every number means something. Every status is actionable. No decorative whitespace where data should be.

This is the inverse of the product site (heavenly, white, spacious). The admin panel is the engine room: dark, efficient, packed with gauges.

Color System

Token Value Usage
--admin-bg #0D1117 Page background. GitHub-dark level.
--admin-bg-card #161B22 Card/panel surfaces
--admin-bg-card-hover #1C2128 Card hover state
--admin-bg-elevated #21262D Modals, dropdowns, tooltips
--admin-border #30363D Borders, dividers
--admin-text #E6EDF3 Primary text
--admin-text-secondary #8B949E Secondary text, labels
--admin-text-muted #484F58 Disabled, tertiary text
--admin-accent #E85D26 Primary actions (AOM orange)
--admin-accent-hover #F06830 Hover on accent
--admin-healthy #3FB950 Healthy status
--admin-degraded #D29922 Degraded/warning status
--admin-down #F85149 Down/error status
--admin-info #58A6FF Informational, links

Typography

Element Font Weight Size Color
Page title Syne 700 28px --admin-text
Section heading Space Grotesk 600 18px --admin-text
Table header Space Grotesk 600 13px --admin-text-secondary
Table cell Space Grotesk 400 14px --admin-text
Stat number (large) Syne 700 36px --admin-text
Stat label Space Grotesk 500 13px --admin-text-secondary
Badge/pill text Space Grotesk 600 12px White on colored bg
Monospace (IDs, slugs) JetBrains Mono 400 13px --admin-text-muted

Global Layout

+--+----------------------------------------------------+
|  |  CORNER FLEET                [Search] [Push Update] |  <- Top bar
|  |-----------------------------------------------------|
|  |                                                      |
|  |  [Stats Row: 4 cards]                               |
|S |                                                      |
|I |  [Main Content Area]                                |
|D |                                                      |
|E |                                                      |
|B |                                                      |
|A |                                                      |
|R |                                                      |
|  |                                                      |
+--+----------------------------------------------------+

Sidebar (Fixed Left)

  • Width: 56px collapsed, 220px expanded (toggle via hamburger or hover)
  • Background: --admin-bg with 1px right border --admin-border
  • Items (icons only when collapsed, icon + label when expanded):
    1. Fleet Overview (grid icon) -- default
    2. Updates (arrow-up-circle icon)
    3. Revenue (dollar-sign icon)
    4. Alerts (bell icon, with count badge if active)
    5. Settings (gear icon)
    7. AOM. logo at bottom (links to main site)
  • Active item: Left 3px orange accent bar, text --admin-text, icon filled
  • Inactive: Text --admin-text-secondary, icon outlined
  • Hover: Background --admin-bg-card
  • Alert badge: Red dot (8px) or count badge at top-right of bell icon

Top Bar

  • Height: 64px
  • Background: --admin-bg-card with 1px bottom border --admin-border
  • Left: Page title (Syne 700, 28px)
  • Right: Search (icon button), "Push Update" (orange button), notification bell, Patrik avatar (32px circle)

Main Content

  • Padding: 24px on all sides
  • Max width: none (full width, data needs room)

View 1: Fleet Overview (Default)

Stats Row (4 Cards)

Four stat cards in a row, equal width.

Card spec:

  • Height: 100px
  • Background: --admin-bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid --admin-border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Padding: 20px
  • Layout: Stat number top-left (Syne 700, 36px), label below (Space Grotesk 500, 13px, secondary), trend arrow + percentage top-right

The four cards:

Card Stat Label Trend
1 12 Total Clients +2 this month (green arrow up)
2 11 Healthy 91.7% (green)
3 1 Degraded -- (yellow dot)
4 $42,000 MRR +$6,000 (green arrow up)

Status-specific card accents:

  • Total: no accent
  • Healthy: thin 2px top border --admin-healthy
  • Degraded: thin 2px top border --admin-degraded
  • MRR: thin 2px top border --admin-accent

Fleet Table

Below the stats row. The main content.

Table spec:

  • Background: --admin-bg-card
  • Border: 1px solid --admin-border
  • Border-radius: 12px
  • Header row: --admin-bg-elevated, Space Grotesk 600, 13px, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em
  • Row height: 56px
  • Row hover: --admin-bg-card-hover
  • Row border: 1px solid --admin-border between rows
  • Clickable: Entire row is clickable, cursor pointer

Columns:

Column Width Content
Client 200px Company name (Space Grotesk 500, 14px) + org slug below (JetBrains Mono 400, 12px, muted)
Status 100px Status pill badge
Agents 80px "4/4" or "3/4" with colored indicator
Uptime 100px "14d 3h"
Last Activity 120px "2 min ago" (relative time)
Plan 80px "$3k" or "$5k"
Actions 80px Three-dot menu

Status Pill Badge

Status Background Text Dot
HEALTHY rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.15) --admin-healthy Pulsing green dot (6px)
DEGRADED rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.15) --admin-degraded Solid yellow dot
DOWN rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.15) --admin-down Solid red dot
STOPPED rgba(139, 148, 158, 0.15) --admin-text-muted No dot

Pill spec: 24px height, 8px horizontal padding, 6px border-radius, 12px font size, Space Grotesk 600.

Agents Column

  • "4/4" = all agents healthy. Green text.
  • "3/4" = one agent down. Yellow text. Tooltip on hover shows which agent is down.

Actions Menu (Three Dot)

Dropdown on click:

  • Restart Container
  • View Logs
  • SSH Terminal
  • Stop Container (red text)

Dropdown spec: --admin-bg-elevated, 1px border --admin-border, 8px border-radius, 180px width, shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4). Items: 36px height, hover --admin-bg-card-hover.

Sorting

  • Click any column header to sort (ascending/descending toggle)
  • Active sort: column header text turns --admin-text, small arrow indicator
  • Default sort: Status (DOWN first, then DEGRADED, then HEALTHY) then alphabetical

Search/Filter

  • Search bar in top bar filters table by client name, org slug, or status
  • Filter chips below table header: "All", "Healthy", "Degraded", "Down", "Stopped"
  • Active chip: --admin-accent background, white text
  • Inactive chip: --admin-bg-elevated, --admin-text-secondary text

View 2: Client Detail

Accessed by clicking any row in the fleet table. Full-page view for one client.

Header Section

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [< Back to Fleet]                                                  |
|                                                                    |
| PHOENIX CPA GROUP                    [Restart] [SSH] [Logs]       |
| phoenix-cpa-group                                                  |
|                                                                    |
| HEALTHY  |  Uptime: 14d 3h 22m  |  Plan: Platform ($3k/mo)      |
| WS: phoenix-cpa-group.ws.corner.app                               |
| Skills: v2026-03-16-002  |  Image: corner-client:2026-03-16      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
  • Back link: --admin-info colored, with left arrow
  • Client name: Syne 700, 28px
  • Org slug: JetBrains Mono 400, 14px, --admin-text-muted
  • Status pill: Same as fleet table
  • Metadata: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, --admin-text-secondary, pipe-separated
  • Action buttons: Outlined style, --admin-border, 36px height. "Restart" default, "SSH" and "Logs" secondary. Red "Stop" button far right.

Two-Column Layout Below Header

Left column (60%):

Agent Status Cards

Each agent gets a card:

+----------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar] Email Triage       IDLE              |
|          Last active: 2 min ago               |
+----------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar] Lead Response      WORKING           |
|          "Responding to John Smith inquiry"   |
+----------------------------------------------+
  • Card height: 72px
  • Card background: --admin-bg-card
  • Avatar: 36px circle, agent accent color background, white initial letter
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 600, 15px
  • Status badge: Same pill style as fleet table but smaller (20px height)
  • Current task: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, --admin-text-secondary, truncated with ellipsis at 40 chars
  • WORKING state: Subtle left border 3px in agent color

Recent Events

Below agent cards. Scrollable list.

14:30  Lead Response completed: "Replied to John Smith"
14:15  Operations started: "Analyzing weekly schedule"
13:45  Calendar completed: "Scheduled meeting with ABC Corp"
  • Timestamp: JetBrains Mono 400, 12px, --admin-text-muted, 60px fixed width
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 500, 13px, agent accent color
  • Event text: Space Grotesk 400, 13px, --admin-text
  • Row height: 32px
  • Max visible: 15 events, scrollable
  • Separator: 1px --admin-border between events

Right column (40%):

Resource Usage

Four mini gauge cards:

+---------------------+
| CPU                  |
| ===---------- 12%  |
| 0.24 / 2 cores      |
+---------------------+
  • Card height: 80px
  • Bar background: --admin-border
  • Bar fill: Gradient based on usage:
    • 0-60%: --admin-healthy
    • 60-80%: --admin-degraded
    • 80-100%: --admin-down
  • Bar height: 6px, 4px border-radius
  • Label: Space Grotesk 600, 13px, top-left
  • Percentage: Space Grotesk 700, 16px, top-right
  • Detail: Space Grotesk 400, 12px, --admin-text-secondary, below bar

Four gauges: CPU, RAM, Disk, WebSocket Connections.

Activity Metrics (7 Day)

Simple stat cards:

Messages: 47  |  Tasks: 23  |  Avg Response: 1.4s

Three mini cards, horizontal, below resource gauges.

Container Info

Below metrics:

  • Container ID (monospace)
  • WS Endpoint (monospace, clickable)
  • Skills version
  • Image version
  • Last restart timestamp

View 3: Update Management

Header

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| UPDATES                                                            |
| Current version: v2026-03-16-002                                  |
| Clients on latest: 11/12                                          |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

Action Buttons Row

Three buttons, equal width:

  1. Push Hot Update (green outline) -- Skills, agent personalities
  2. Push Warm Update (yellow outline) -- WS Bridge restart
  3. Schedule Cold Update (red outline) -- Full image update

Each opens a confirmation modal with details of what will happen.

Update History Table

Version Type Date Status Action
v2026-03-16-002 HOT 03/16 08:00 12/12 success [Rollback]
v2026-03-16-001 HOT 03/16 04:00 12/12 success [Rollback]
v2026-03-15-001 COLD 03/15 02:00 11/12 success [Details]
  • Type badge:
    • HOT: Green badge
    • WARM: Yellow badge
    • COLD: Red badge (matches the severity/risk level)
  • Status: "12/12 success" in green, or "11/12" with orange text linking to details

Push Update Modal

When clicking any push button:

+---------------------------------------+
|  Push Hot Update                  [X]  |
|---------------------------------------|
|  Changes:                              |
|  - Updated email triage skill          |
|  - New calendar booking flow           |
|  - Agent personality refresh           |
|                                        |
|  Affected clients: 12                  |
|  Estimated downtime: None              |
|                                        |
|  [Cancel]              [Push to All]   |
+---------------------------------------+
  • Modal background: --admin-bg-elevated
  • Overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
  • Width: 480px
  • Border-radius: 16px
  • "Push to All" button: Green for hot, yellow for warm, red for cold
  • Changes list: Parsed from git diff or commit messages

Pending Updates Section

Below the table. Shows any scheduled cold updates.

Scottsdale Law needs cold update
Auto-scheduled: 03/17 02:00 MST (client's local time)
[Reschedule]  [Force Now]

View 4: Revenue Dashboard

Stats Row (4 Cards)

Card Stat Label
1 $42,000 Monthly Recurring Revenue
2 12 Active Clients
3 $3,500 Average MRR/Client
4 ~88% Gross Margin

Revenue Table

Client Plan MRR Status Since
Phoenix CPA Platform $3,000 Active Jan 2026
Mesa Electric Platform+ $5,000 Active Feb 2026
  • Sorted by MRR descending
  • "Platform" and "Platform+" as badge labels
  • "Since" column shows how long they've been paying

Revenue Chart (Optional Enhancement)

Area chart showing MRR over time. --admin-accent fill with 20% opacity area. X-axis: months. Y-axis: dollars.

  • Chart background: --admin-bg-card
  • Grid lines: --admin-border at 10% opacity
  • Data line: --admin-accent, 2px
  • Data points: 6px circles at monthly markers
  • Tooltip on hover: Shows exact MRR for that month

Infrastructure Cost Summary

Small card below the table:

Infrastructure: $320/mo  |  Supabase: $25/mo  |  Total: $345/mo
Net margin: $41,655/mo (99.2%)

Alerts View

Alert List

Real-time alerts from the fleet.

[!] Scottsdale Law: Agent "calendar" unresponsive for 5 min    2 min ago   [Restart Agent]
[!] Mesa Electric: Disk usage at 78%                           15 min ago  [Expand Storage]
[i] System: Skills v2026-03-16-002 rolled out successfully     1 hr ago    [Details]
  • Alert types:
    • Critical (red left border): Container down, agent crash, health check failed
    • Warning (yellow left border): High resource usage, degraded performance
    • Info (blue left border): Updates applied, routine events
  • Row height: 56px
  • Unread: Bolder text, subtle left glow in alert color
  • Action button: Outlined, right-aligned

Alert Sound (Optional)

Critical alerts trigger a browser notification (with permission) and a subtle notification badge on the sidebar bell icon.

Responsive

Desktop (1280px+)

Full two-column layouts. Sidebar expanded by default.

Tablet (768px-1279px)

Sidebar collapsed by default (icons only). Two-column detail view stacks to single column.

Mobile (390px-767px)

No sidebar. Bottom tab bar with 4 icons (Fleet, Updates, Revenue, Alerts). Fleet table becomes a card list. Detail view is single column. Stats row becomes 2x2 grid.

Animations

Keep them minimal. This is a power tool, not a showcase.

  • Page transitions: None. Instant rendering.
  • Card hover: 100ms ease-out background change
  • Dropdown: 100ms ease-out fade + translateY(-4px to 0)
  • Status pill pulse: Only for HEALTHY (subtle, every 3s)
  • Progress bars (resource gauges): 300ms ease-out on initial render
  • Modals: 150ms fade in, 100ms fade out

No page-level animations. No stagger reveals. No parallax. Speed over spectacle.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Key Action
1 Fleet Overview
2 Updates
3 Revenue
4 Alerts
/ Focus search
Esc Close modal / back to fleet
R Refresh current view
? Show shortcuts help

The admin panel is Patrik's cockpit. Dense, dark, fast. He opens it once and sees everything. No clicking around hunting for info. One glance: who's healthy, who's not, how much money is coming in. That's the bar.
